note: Machine-readable capability map of the REA tool surface, derived from a live tools/list call. Use it to pick the right tool family for a task instead of guessing names. Regenerate with rea/dump_tools.py.
invariants: Every tool operates on an explicitly opened document (see the session family).
Conclusions should be recorded via the evidence family; bundles are sha256-pinned.
Nothing in this surface executes a sample; captures are bounded and caller-scoped.
A missing capability is reported, never invented.

golden_chain.why: identify the artifact, get arch + sha256
size the surface; pick real functions
capture the provenance of a claim
